ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure, with a benzene ring on the left and a phenyl group on the right; in the middle is a cyclic/transition-state skeleton containing O, C, and N, and a CO2H group is connected at the upper right. There are also several curved arrows in the figure indicating electron movement, an H label adjacent to O at the upper left, H also on N, and H also contained in CO2H. Counting reasoning: Exclude all bonds involving hydrogen as required, and do not count curved arrows; count only connections between heavy atoms. The left benzene ring has 6 heavy-atom bonds within the ring; the right benzene ring has 6 heavy-atom bonds within the ring; in the middle O/C/N transition-state skeleton, there are 6 heavy-atom bonds connecting the aromatic ring, central carbon, aliphatic carbon, N, and the like; the CO2H part counts the connection bond to the central carbon and the two C-O bonds, for a total of 3. The total is 6 + 6 + 6 + 3 = 21.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it shows a left aromatic ring connected into a central O/C/N-containing transition-state framework, a CO2H group above/right of the central carbon, and a right phenyl ring; curved arrows indicate electron movement and must not be counted. Then cross out all H-involving bonds/labels and arrows. Count each remaining heavy-atom connection once by region: 6 bonds around the left benzene ring, 6 bonds around the right phenyl ring, 6 heavy-atom bonds in the central O/C/N-containing framework connecting the aryl/core/aliphatic/N atoms, and 3 bonds associated with the CO2H substituent connection and its two C–O bonds. Add these regional counts to obtain 21.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a connected heavy-atom skeleton with two aromatic rings, a central cyclic framework containing O/N/C atoms, and a CO2H substituent, plus nonstructural curved arrows and H labels. Ignore arrows and all hydrogens. Count the non-H vertices in the line drawing, including implicit carbons at unlabeled skeletal corners; the structure gives 19 heavy atoms. Count the independent cycles visible in the skeleton: the left aromatic ring, the right phenyl ring, and the central ring/framework cycle, giving R = 3. Apply the connected-graph relation E = V - 1 + R = 19 - 1 + 3 = 21 heavy-atom bonds.
